comment: The outputs carry whatever is patched into the row, and the fade envelope itself when nothing is, so they are left without a family. The fade button on each row is a custom widget rather than a parameter. The gate input is read with two different normal voltages in the source: 0V when the row is down and 1V when it is up, so an empty jack neither starts nor ends a fade and the row is driven by its button alone.
